title: Etale residue triple colimit representative
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $p$ a prime, $K$ a field, and $\chi:\kappa(p)\to K$ a field homomorphism. Let $D$ be the forgetful ring diagram of [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples], and let $c$ be a colimit cocone for $D$. For every $x\in c.\mathrm{pt}$, there are a triple $t$ and an element $f\in t.B$ such that $c.\iota_t(f)=x$.

proof.text: The category of triples is filtered by lem-weil-pbc-etale-triples-filtered-colimit-filtered, whose statement permits arbitrary K and fixed chi.

Inside the vertex C of the given cocone, let S consist of all coprojection images. The identity triple represents zero and one, and negatives stay at the same stage. A common successor for two representing objects, together with cocone naturality and the ring-homomorphism laws, represents their sum and product. Therefore S is a subring of C. Each coprojection corestricts to S and its naturality follows by injectivity of the inclusion S -> C.

Apply the given colimit universal property to the cocone with vertex S to obtain d:C -> S. The composite C -> S -> C agrees with the identity after every coprojection, so it is the identity by colimit uniqueness. Thus each x in C is the underlying value of d(x), which belongs to S, and membership in S provides its representative. This argument is independent of the size of the indexing category.

proof_origin: Stacks Project Tags 04GN and 04GP, filtered-colimit representatives step; D2 second reader supplies the elementary subring and colimit-uniqueness argument, checked in Lean with filteredness as an explicit assumption, 2026-10-12.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleResidueTriples_colimit_representative
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K χ)) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (x : c.pt) : ∃ (t : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (f : t.B),
      (c.ι.app t).hom f = x

mathlib_searches.verdict: Mathlib constructs filtered ring colimits and their representatives; this result additionally requires filteredness and essential smallness of the category of triples.
